conditions_of_use: Permitted in specified food classes as benzoic acid equivalent. Max 120 ppm in carbonated beverages; max 1000 ppm in sauces/pickles.
regulation_version: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011 (Amended 2021)
notes: Must be declared on label as 'Preservative (INS 211)'.

conditions_of_use: GRAS under 21 CFR 184.1733 when used as an antimicrobial agent up to 0.1 percent level in finished food.
notes: FDA guidance advises monitoring potential formation of benzene in beverages containing both benzoate and ascorbic acid.

conditions_of_use: Max 150 mg/l in flavoured non-alcoholic drinks; max 1000 mg/kg in sauces under Annex II of Regulation (EC) 1333/2008.
notes: Group ADI with benzoic acid established at 5 mg/kg bw/day by EFSA.

conditions_of_use: Retained Regulation (EC) 1333/2008 applies. Subject to maximum use levels of 150 mg/l in water-based flavoured drinks.
regulation_version: Food Additives, Flavourings, Enzymes and Extraction Solvents (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019
notes: Subject to retained GB register of authorized food additives.

conditions_of_use: Permitted in List of Permitted Class 2 Preservatives (Lists of Permitted Food Additives). Maximum level 1000 ppm in juices, jams, and marinades.
regulation_version: List of Permitted Class 2 Preservatives (Lists of Permitted Food Additives - Health Canada)
notes: Must be declared on the list of ingredients.

conditions_of_use: Permitted at level of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) across specified food categories.
notes: Standard acidity regulator and antioxidant synergist.

conditions_of_use: Affirmed as GRAS under 21 CFR 184.1033 with no limitation other than current good manufacturing practice.
notes: GRAS substance.

conditions_of_use: Approved under Group I additives at quantum satis.
regulation_version: Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 Annex II Part C
notes: No numerical ADI required.

conditions_of_use: Permitted at quantum satis across multiple food categories in retained EU legislation.
notes: General approved acidity regulator.

conditions_of_use: Listed on List of Permitted pH Adjusting Agents, Acid-Reacting Materials and Water Correcting Agents under GMP.
regulation_version: Lists of Permitted Food Additives - Health Canada
notes: Permitted food acidulant.

conditions_of_use: Permitted at GMP in broad categories; specific limit in cocoa and chocolate products (max 0.5% - 1.0%).
notes: Must declare botanical source (e.g. soy) if derived from allergenic food.

conditions_of_use: Affirmed as GRAS under 21 CFR 184.1400 with no limitation other than GMP.
notes: Must comply with FALCPA allergen labelling if derived from soy.

conditions_of_use: Group I food additive at quantum satis. Allergen labelling mandatory if soy-derived under Regulation (EU) 1169/2011.
notes: Re-evaluated by EFSA in 2020: no safety concern at reported uses.

conditions_of_use: Permitted at quantum satis under retained GB regulations with allergen labeling provisions.
notes: General approved emulsifier.

conditions_of_use: Permitted in List of Permitted Emulsifying, Gelling, Stabilizing or Thickening Agents at GMP.
regulation_version: List of Permitted Emulsifying, Gelling, Stabilizing or Thickening Agents - Health Canada
notes: Soy declaration required under Canadian allergen guidelines.

conditions_of_use: Permitted synthetic food colour in specified food items not exceeding 100 ppm (or 200 ppm in canned products).
regulation_version: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011
notes: Mandatory declaration: 'Contains permitted synthetic food colour [INS 102]'.

conditions_of_use: Subject to batch certification under 21 CFR 74.705. Label must specifically list 'FD&C Yellow No. 5'.
notes: Mandatory specific name declaration to alert individuals allergic to tartrazine.

conditions_of_use: Maximum limits vary between 50 and 500 mg/kg depending on food category. Mandatory warning label required.
notes: Mandatory warning statement: 'May have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children'.

conditions_of_use: Retained regulation specifies category limits and the Southampton six warning label.
notes: Requires label warning: 'May have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children'.

conditions_of_use: Permitted in List of Permitted Colouring Agents subject to specific category limits (usually 100-300 ppm).
regulation_version: List of Permitted Colouring Agents - Health Canada
notes: Must be declared on the label as 'tartrazine'.
